messages:
raj: FYI discovered a migration/backfill hiccup on staging just now. Running the role schema sanitizer inserted a default role mapping that effectively granted service accounts `*:*` in a few namespaces. :eyes:

anna: whoa. how did that slip past the prechecks?

raj: looks like a mis-constructed default for `role_defaults` when the legacy `rolemap` field was absent — code path assumed permissive default. repro steps below.

maria: can you paste the exact query/patch that caused it?

raj: here — migration snippet from the job logs:
```
INSERT INTO roles (name, permissions) VALUES ('default-admin', '["*"]') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
UPDATE service_account_roles SET role = coalesce(role, 'default-admin') WHERE role IS NULL;
```

sam: ouch. that `['*']` serialization kills us. Is this only on staging or did it hit prod?

deploybot: migration-job/1778500000 started on prod-canary at 2026-03-20T15:03:22Z

raj: we had a canary window that ran on a small prod shard before full rollout. looks like the canary applied the bad default to ~12 service accounts.

oliver: are the accounts active? any sign of misuse? audit logs?

maria: checked CloudTrail-like logs: no suspicious API patterns, but there are a few admin-level calls from a CI runner. probable escalation risk if left.

security-bot: alert triggered: privilege-escalation-risk detected for 12 principals. Ticket: SEC-3842

sam: immediate plan: 1) pause rollout; 2) revert canary role assignments; 3) run a safe backfill to fix default mapping; 4) add pre-deploy guard for wildcard perms.

raj: agreed. I paused the rollout and queued a rollback script to restore prior role values from the snapshot taken pre-migration.

anna: KMS question — will the rollback need key access? we encrypt role metadata with KMS key `roles-metadata-v2` for private deploys.

maria: rollback touches plaintext role names only, but rotation isn't required. we do need decrypt permissions for the snapshot retrieval. @ops please grant temporary decrypt to rollback job.

sre-oncall: granted decrypt for the `migration-rollback` principal for 30m. proceed when ready.

raj: running the rollback now. will update when done.

[~3m later]

raj: rollback applied to the canary shard. verified service accounts no longer show wildcard perms. running regression smoke tests across canary and staging.

sam: good. next we need a patched migration that never writes a wildcard default. proposal:
- treat missing rolemap as `no-default` (explicit null)
- backfill only when there's an explicit default in org config
- add DB constraint preventing `permissions` = `['*']` unless `is_system_role = true`

anna: add an extra check in the migration runner: query planned writes and fail fast if any role has `'*'` in perms.

raj: I'm coding this now. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/infra/merge_requests/4823

maria: also add an audit log event for any migration that mutates role assignments with a list of changed principals and a before/after snapshot stored in S3 (kms-encrypted). Good for compliance.

oliver: we should also add an alert rule: any non-human principal gaining admin-level perms within 10m triggers SEC and oncall.

sam: agree. make it part of the rollout gating. if the canary sees >0 new admin principals, abort.

raj: updated PR to include the pre-deploy guard and DB check. running tests locally then will push canary patch.

deploybot: CI: infra/migrations/4823 tests passed (unit/integration) — 12m

raj: can someone review quickly? it's blocking the full rollout.

anna: reviewing now. also verify the PR has KMS usage documented — `s3://redwood-sec-backups/SEC-3842/` and the KMS key policy that allows the rollback job.

maria: LGTM with one nit: change error message to call out exact offending principal IDs for easier triage.

anna: approved.

raj: deploying patched migration to canary shard (dry-run mode with `--audit-only` flag first).

[~6m later]

deploybot: migration-job/1778500000 dry-run complete. No wildcard defaults present. Audit snapshot uploaded to s3://redwood-sec-backups/SEC-3842/dryrun.json (kms:roles-metadata-v2)

sre-oncall: ran smoke tests — good. no escalations.

raj: rolling to canary (write mode) now with the safe checks enabled. ETA 10m.

[~12m later]

raj: canary completed, no new issues. full rollout scheduled in 30m with monitoring and auto-abort.

sam: postmortem/next-steps:
- add unit test for `role_defaults` absence
- add CI job that runs migration dry-run on a sanitized snapshot
- improve migration docs + checklist for KMS decrypt perms
- create a lightweight canary that samples principals before/after and compares

maria: filing a short incident note and linking SEC-3842. I'll own the remediation checklist.

raj: thanks everyone. big takeaway: never default to permissive on missing legacy fields. :raised_hands:

anna: add a policy lint rule to the infra repo to reject `['*']` in role definitions unless explicit system flag present. :white_check_mark:

sre-oncall: closing canary now. full rollout proceeding with guardrails.
